question: Who was the renowned Indian Carnatic singer and the first artist to receive both the Bharat Ratna and the Ramon Magsaysay Award?
solution:
The correct answer is __**MS Subbulakshmi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The renowned Indian Carnatic singer who was the first artist to receive both the Bharat Ratna and the Ramon Magsaysay Award is **M. S. Subbulakshmi.**
 
• **Born** on September **16, 1916, in Madurai, Tamil Nadu, India.**
 
• She was awarded the** Bharat Ratna in 1998**, which is India's highest civilian award.
 
• She received the **Ramon Magsaysay Award** for her contribution to the arts in **1974**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lata Mangeshkar **was Born on September 28, 1929, in Indore, Madhya Pradesh, India.
 
• **Bharat Ratna (2001)** - India's highest civilian award and **Padma Bhushan (1969) and Padma Vibhushan (1999).**
 
• **Asha Bhosle **was Born on September 8, 1933, in Sangli, Maharashtra, India.
 
• **Dadasaheb Phalke Award (2000)** - India's highest award in cinema, **Padma Bhushan (2008) and Padma Vibhushan (2011)**.
 
• **Mangalampalli Balamuralikrishna** was Born on July 6, 1930, in Sankaraguptam, Andhra Pradesh, India.
 
• **Padma Bhushan (1985), Padma Vibhushan (2005) Sangeet Natak Akademi Award**, and several other state and national awards.
